info.description: Two pictures side by side, in one row.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Layout
edit.description: How the row is divided. Equal gives both pictures the same width; wide first gives the first one more.

edit.label: Images
edit.description: Exactly two, in the order they are shown.
